blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The lawyers of Sen. Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa have again knocked on the doors of the Supreme Court, seeking to reverse its earlier ruling and grant the lawmaker protection against any attempt to arrest and surrender him to the International Criminal Court (ICC). Atty. Israelito Torreon’s law firm submitted a manifestation dated Oct. 27, seeking an urgent resolution of the motion for reconsideration it filed in June. READ: SC junks Bato dela Rosa petition for TRO vs ICC arrest The same manifestation also asks the high tribunal to issue a temporary restraining order against Dela Rosa’s looming arrest […]...
